<!-- Generated by go run ./internal/conn3x/provider/moddoc in conn3xorg/conn3x. Don't edit by hand. -->

One public key in a user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.

```hcl
step "example" {
  authorized_key {
    key = "..."
    user = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | string | Yes | Public key, in authorized_keys format. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "delete" (default) removes the key, so a rotated key stops working; "forget" leaves it. |
| `state` | string | No | "present" (default) or "absent". |
| `user` | string | Yes | The account the key logs in as. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_authorized_key.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether authorized_keys already matches. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_authorized_key` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
